editorial: Today, there is a movement focusing on developer tools and artificial intelligence engineering (AI engineering) practices. Projects that automate open source data analytics and code review processes on GitHub are gaining popularity.

items.title: Robbyant/lingbot-map
items.summary: Lingbot-map is a feed-forward foundation model developed for scene reconstruction from streaming data. It provides a solution for modeling three-dimensional environments with real-time streaming data.

items.title: apache/ossie
items.summary: Apache Ossie is an initiative that aims to standardize the exchange of semantic metadata between analytics, artificial intelligence and business intelligence (BI) platforms. This project aims to create a vendor-independent, single source of truth for semantic data.

items.title: PostHog/posthog
items.summary: PostHog combines tools such as AI observability, session recording and bug tracking on a single platform to optimize product development processes. Thanks to these tools, developers can manage autonomous product workflows by analyzing user data.

items.title: ibelick/ui-skills
items.summary: Developed for design engineers, ui-skills brings together the technical skills and competencies needed in user interface (UI) development processes. This TypeScript-based resource presents interface-focused software development standards and methodologies with a structured curriculum.

items.title: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
items.summary: Prepared for those who want to enter the field of artificial intelligence engineering (AI engineering), this resource aims to teach end-to-end application development processes using Python. This study, which puts theoretical knowledge into practice, covers the design and deployment of artificial intelligence-based software.

items.title: tirth8205/code-review-graph
items.summary: Code-review-graph creates a local map of the code base, providing a code intelligence graph that ensures that AI-powered software tools process only relevant sections. This method increases efficiency by providing context reduction in workflows and code review processes in large projects.

items.title: elder-plinius/G0DM0D3
items.summary: G0DM0D3 is a liberated AI chat interface that aims to bypass the security layers of large language models. Developed with TypeScript, this open source project allows users to interact with models without restrictions.

items.title: lyogavin/airllm
items.summary: AirLLM allows large language models with 70 billion parameters to be run with only 4 gigabytes of video card memory (VRAM). This library enables high-capacity models to infer on low-end systems by using memory optimization techniques.

items.title: KnockOutEZ/wigolo
items.summary: Wigolo is a tool that provides local-first search, data extraction and crawling capabilities for artificial intelligence coding agents. This system, which works over the model context protocol (MCP), provides free research without cloud dependency and without requiring an API key.

items.title: codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build Your Own X is a resource list that aims to improve programming skills by coding popular software technologies from scratch. Developers learn the working logic of complex systems such as databases or operating systems through hands-on projects.

items.title: MoonshotAI/kimi-cli
items.summary: Developed by Moonshot AI, Kimi CLI is an artificial intelligence agent that works via a command line interface (CLI). This Python-based tool is designed to automate command line interactions in software development processes.

items.title: LG monitors silently install software through Windows Update without consent
items.summary: LG monitors install software in the background via Windows Update without user approval. This brings up security and user control discussions regarding the inclusion of additional applications in the system as well as hardware drivers.

items.title: GPT-5.6 used a prompt to close a 30-year gap in convex optimization
items.summary: Artificial intelligence models have solved a mathematical problem that has not been solved for thirty years in the field of convex optimization with the help of a simple command. This development demonstrates the capacity of large language models to make logical inferences from complex mathematical proofs.

items.title: Mayor Mamdani Says Landlords Can't Use AI Images to Advertise
items.summary: Mayor Mamdani introduced a regulation banning landlords from secretly using AI-generated images in rental property listings. This application aims to increase visual transparency in housing advertisements and prevent digital manipulation.

items.title: Speech Recognition and TTS in less than 500kb
items.summary: The Moonshine project offers speech recognition and text-to-speech models with a size of less than 500 kilobytes. These lightweight frameworks enable native language processing capabilities on systems with limited hardware resources.

items.title: If You Build It, They Will Come
items.summary: It is argued that creating a user base in software projects is directly related to marketing and community interaction rather than the technical quality of the product. It is emphasized that developers should focus on user acquisition strategies rather than a product-oriented approach.

items.title: thinkingmachines/Inkling
items.summary: Developed by Thinking Machines, Inkling is a multimodal model that produces text-based outputs by accepting visual and textual data as input. The system supports content production processes by analyzing the interaction between image and text.

items.title: prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-27B-gguf
items.summary: Ternary-Bonsai-27B-gguf is a language model optimized for text generation and minified with low-bit quantization techniques. This model supports high-performance inference processes by using hardware resources efficiently.

items.title: prism-ml/Bonsai-27B-gguf
items.summary: Bonsai-27B, developed by Prism-ml, is a language model optimized for text generation tasks. The model is presented in quantized GGUF format to provide high-performance inference.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.2
items.summary: GLM-5.2, published by Zai-org, is a language model optimized for text-generation tasks. This model, which receives high interaction on the HuggingFace platform, is used in extensive text creation processes.

items.title: empero-ai/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M-GGUF
items.summary: Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M is an artificial intelligence model that produces text output (image-text-to-text) by processing visual and text data. This model, presented in GGUF format, provides the opportunity to analyze different data types with high context window support.
